title: 11 Ferrow: spend management hero
strengths: The product is the picture, flat, whole and at 1:1 inside the 12-column grid: an 'October close' screen with '1,284 of 1,302 ready to post', a ledger table of cards and bills, and a drawer whose journal entry ('Dr 6420 Repairs 1,284.50 / Cr 2010 Card clearing') is a detail only a spend platform would show

One regular-weight headline that says what it does ('Company spend that reaches your ledger already coded.'), a plain kicker naming who it is for, and one button with a human caption ('A 30-minute call, no slides')

Product craft matches the B2B study: 13 px body, tabular right-aligned amounts with 'amounts in USD' in the table footer, a Source column with a card or bill icon, status as a word with a colored dot only on exceptions, hairline rows, one blue accent; every count reconciles (1,284 of 1,302 = 98.6%, 11 + 5 + 2 = 18 exceptions, 1,206 posted + 78 tonight = 1,284)
slop_signals: Conventional SaaS hero layout: eyebrow, two-line headline left, paragraph and one button right, product frame on a pale lavender band
Generic royal-blue primary and a plain text wordmark; nothing besides the product UI is ownable by this brand
Brand name 'Ferrow' sits one letter-swap from 'Ferrule' (product/06) in the same B2B set
fixes: Rename Ferrow (or Ferrule) so the two B2B brands are not confusable

Rename reused people and merchants: Mirela Kovač (Quoin has Kovač Structural), Tomás I. (Corvane's Tomás Herrera), Calder Inn (Quoin's Calder & Voss), Kettle & Co. (styles/09 Kettle Robotics), card ••4417 (Kilnworks, app-screens/01)
Give the brand one owned element (a mark, a typographic detail or an accent with a job) so the page is not only a well-made template

references.what: Centered headline with a one-sentence proof and one lime CTA; theirs owns a color, ours uses a generic blue
Headline, sub-line, one action, real photo; ours replaces the photo with the actual product
Product fragment beside a serif headline; ours shows the product flat and whole, which reads more credible

facts: The header is still the stock kicker, two-line headline, paragraph and button
The brand blue (#2c3fd0) is generic; only its job was narrowed
check_dates.py flags 'Monday 3 November' in notes.md, which quotes the old error (false positive)
fixed: Brand Ferrow (one letter from Ferrule) renamed Purlin across index.html, notes, DESIGN.md, PRODUCT.md and the opendesigner folder (resolver file renamed purlin.resolver.json); web search found no spend-management company called Purlin
Names: Mirela Kovač / Mirela K. → Petra Szabo / Petra S.; Tomás I. → Arjun D.; Calder Inn → Kingsmere Inn; Kettle & Co. Catering → Harvest Table Catering; Corran Labs → Brindle Food Labs
Selected amount $1,284.50 (same digits as '1,284 of 1,302') → $1,318.40; journal entry still balances

changed: One owned element made big: a full-width October ledger at the top of the product, one column per night from 1 Oct to the day the books lock, 27 nights adding to 1,206, tonight's 78 as the one blue bar, an ink 'Books lock, Tue 3 Nov' rule
Blue has one job (what posts tonight); the button and links are ink, the selection neutral
Finance logic made consistent: rows say Posts tonight, Posted with that night's journal entry (one per night), or are held; 1,206 + 78 + 18 = 1,302; USD books in Eastern time
A Z-purlin mark; the lavender band removed; cents in a lighter tone; tabs on their own row; ledger settings in the sidebar; the table footer under the last row and Edit coding in the drawer header
